name: Strike-out claim
looks: A short headline sets up the problem, then a hand-drawn-style line strikes through the one word naming it, the rest of the headline landing around it and often closing on an accent-coloured word that states the fix.
build: Headline set before the strike so it never reflows. The struck word gets a single diagonal/horizontal stroke drawn on (strokeDashoffset, 200-300ms) with a slight hand-wobble path so it reads as drawn, not generated. Struck word drops to ~60% opacity once marked; the rest of the headline holds full strength.
sound: A single marker-pen scribble/whoosh exactly as the strike draws on.
prompt: Set a short headline naming the problem, then draw a hand-style strike-through line across the one word that names it, as the rest of the line lands around it and closes on an accent-coloured word stating the fix, so the whole line reads as problem-named-then-solved in one breath.
